lines.zh: 红沙上留不下我的脚印。
lines.en: My footprints do not stay on red sand.
I walk lightly, like a flake of ash.
The wind pushes the flame behind me.
My hut is over there. The smoke lingers.
I count the cracks in the ground.
My hem is caked with red dust.
Step by step, the fire follows me.
That rock ahead has cracked from heat.
The road is too bright. I squint.

lines.zh: 我踩过的地方草不长了。
lines.en: Grass stops growing where I step.
I tap my staff on the ground.
Walk slowly. Fire is in no hurry.

lines.zh: 我在指尖捻出一点火星。
lines.en: I roll a spark between my fingers.
Smoke seeps from my sleeve.
I hum a tuneless little song.
That skull circles around me.
I count the colors in the flame.
Ash settles on my shoulder. I leave it.
The tip of my staff is warm.

lines.zh: 风干的骨头敲起来好听。
lines.en: Dry bone sounds pleasant when tapped.

lines.zh: 我望着地平线上的热气。
lines.en: I watch the heat shimmer on the horizon.
The fire rests. So do I.

lines.zh: 你看起来，不像会烧起来。
lines.en: You do not look like you would burn.
I look up. My eyes are orange.
You do not smell of smoke.
Standing that far off. Afraid of me?

lines.zh: 火光把你的影子拖到墙根。
lines.en: Firelight drags your shadow to the wall.
I tilt my head and blink slowly.
Your boots carry red sand.
I am watching your hands, not your face.
You smile. I smile too.
Staring like that could start a fire.
I shiver. Ash falls off me.
You hit me. How surprising.
The staff nearly left my hand.
I cough, and sparks come out.
I will note this in the ash.
Stop. My sleeve is torn.
I step back. Not from fear.
You are stronger than you look.
The flame has dropped a notch.
Pain is a kind of heat. I know it.
Food? Fire does not eat.
Hand me wood and I am happier.
That bread would toast nicely.
A torch? I can light my own.
I accept your coal. Thank you.
That smell is like burnt sugar.
What you hold is not dry enough.
Do not hand it over. It will burn you.

lines.zh: 我喜欢能烧很久的东西。
lines.en: I like things that burn a long time.

lines.zh: 我不追人，除非你点着了。
lines.en: I chase no one, unless you catch fire.
You touch me. My sleeve smokes.
Sorry. My ash rubs onto you.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，像两块炭。
lines.en: We meet like two coals.
I step back. I might burn you.
You knock me askew. Sparks scatter.
Do not crowd me. The skull is overhead.
That bump cost me my staff.
You carry a chill with you.
I steady you. My hand is hot.
After the bump, we both step back.
Would you sit by the fire with me?
Two tending a fire makes the night shorter.

lines.zh: 我把最暖的位置留给你。
lines.en: I saved the warmest spot for you.
Not too close. Your sleeve will catch.
I would like to draw your shadow.

lines.zh: 火堆旁的空位一直空着。
lines.en: The place by the fire stayed empty.
You do not fear fire. That is rare.

lines.zh: 我们一起看它烧到天亮。
lines.en: Let us watch it burn until dawn.

lines.zh: 我把手杖横在我们中间。
lines.en: I lay my staff between us.
With you here, even the smoke thins.
I pick up a black stone.
This wood is properly dry.
A fire charge rolls to my feet. I keep it.
The emerald feels cold in my hand.
I pick things up with two fingers.

lines.zh: 这东西烧起来会是什么色？
lines.en: What color would this burn?
I bury it in the ash.

lines.zh: 捡到的骨头，能做个新头。
lines.en: A found bone could make a new skull.
I blow the sand off it.
There are already three in my pocket.
You stepped inside my ring of ash.
I raise my hand. Fire arrives.
Turn around. Do not show me your back.
I have burned this ground three times.
I write your name in smoke.
I dislike noisy guests.
I smiled. You did not see it.
Leave while the ash is still cool.
My skull has woken.
Standing in the ash makes you a target.
The ring of fire has closed.
I point my staff at you.
This will burn for a long while.
Do you smell it? Wood is burning.

lines.zh: 我的手杖一响，你就跑不掉了。
lines.en: My staff clicks, and you are not getting away.

lines.zh: 你走的是下风处，味道全送我。
lines.en: You walk downwind. All your scent comes to me.
You did not bring enough water. I checked.
Flames line up between my fingers.
I murmur softly, as if soothing a child.
The skull drifts behind you.
Three, two, one. I am counting.
Armor will not save you from heat.
I step back. The fire steps forward.

lines.zh: 地上那圈灰，是我的界线。
lines.en: That gray ring is my boundary.
Do you hear the crackling?
I wait for you to walk in yourself.
Fire requires a little patience.
My staff grows hot. It feels good.
Do not run for water. I calculated that.
Smoke arrives first. Fire follows.
Under your feet, it is already warm.

lines.zh: 我慢慢绕，让你一直面向太阳。
lines.en: I circle slowly, keeping the sun in your eyes.

lines.zh: 你身后那道墙，我烧过一遍。
lines.en: I have burned that wall behind you before.
I burn your path, not you. For now.

lines.zh: 你退到岩缝里，热会追进去。
lines.en: You back into a crevice. Heat follows.

lines.zh: 我数你的脚步，第三下你停。
lines.en: I count your steps. You stop at the third.

lines.zh: 骷髅头在你头顶盘旋，很耐心。
lines.en: The skull circles above you, patient.
I tap your knee with my staff's end.
My palm leaves a brand.
That one burned through the sleeve.
I am not good at hitting people. Truly.
Sparks fly into your face.
You retreat. The fire does not.
The staff tip leaves a black line.
Does it hurt? I expected worse.
I shoulder you, heat and all.
The skull snaps at your ankle.
Up close, the fire shrinks.
I blow, and the flame lunges.
This distance suits me.
I block with my hand. My knuckles burn.

lines.zh: 我用杖头戳你，只是提醒。
lines.en: I poke you with the staff head. Just a reminder.

lines.zh: 我一靠近，我的火就变小。
lines.en: When I come close, my fire shrinks.
I come out from behind the dune.
My hut's smoke arrives before I do.
This badland has always been dry.
I shake the ash from my sleeve.
Who is standing at my door?
The torch still burns. I left it.
Strong wind today. Fire will travel far.
I knock the sand off my staff.
A guest. I must light a fire.
I lift my head slowly.

lines.zh: 红沙上又多了一行脚印。
lines.en: One more line of prints on red sand.

lines.zh: 这颗骷髅头，是我新做的。
lines.en: I made this skull recently.
Quiet here. Good for burning things.
I smell it. You carry iron.

lines.zh: 火伤不了我，只是有点痒。
lines.en: Fire cannot hurt me. It only tickles.
I fall, and ash fills my face.
Water? I truly fear water.
The blast leaves my ears buzzing.
An arrow in my shoulder feels cold.
Magic smothers my fire.
Fire lives on wood. I live on fire.
That fire in the sky is bigger than mine.
Not even ash here.
